THESCALED-PREDATORY_INSTINCT.description: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{EnemyAmbushGain}[/blue] [gold]Ambush[/gold] to ALL enemies.
THESCALED-PREDATORY_INSTINCT.title: Predatory Instincts
THESCALED-ABHORRENT_MASS.description: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] random [gold]{Relics:plural:Relic|Relics}[/gold] from other Act 3 [gold]Ancients[/gold] and add [blue]{AbyssCards:diff()}[/blue] [purple]Abyss[/purple] cards to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
THESCALED-ABHORRENT_MASS.title: Abhorrent Mass
THESCALED-ACE_OF_CUPS.description: Every other card you play or discard is shuffled into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THESCALED-ACE_OF_CUPS.title: Ace Of Cups
THESCALED-EYE_OF_THE_ORACLE.title: Eye Of The Oracle
THESCALED-HAND_OF_THE_KING.title: Hand Of The King
THESCALED-HEART_OF_THE_SEA.title: Heart Of The Sea
THESCALED-ROTTEN_DIAPHRAGM.description: The first card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] each turn is sent to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] instead. Up to 1 [purple]Curse[/purple] can now appear in card rewards.
THESCALED-ROTTEN_DIAPHRAGM.title: Rotten Diaphragm
THESCALED-ROYAL_FLUSH.description: At the start of each combat, discard you hand, then draw that many cards. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
THESCALED-ROYAL_FLUSH.title: Royal Flush
THESCALED-SALT_BANDAGES.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] an Attack or Skill with [purple]Adhesive[/purple].
THESCALED-SALT_BANDAGES.title: Salt Bandages
THESCALED-SEA_URCHIN.description: At the start of each combat, exhaust a random unupgraded card in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
THESCALED-SEA_URCHIN.title: Sea Urchin
